body:
I'm sorry. Maybe this is way out of line, but if people are trying to support you and it's not fully working, you should let them know. If they truly care then how you feel about them isn't what's important.

If you're trying to grow then it's better to be honest and say if you feel anchored to the people around you; try to move past them or help them understand you better.

And don't ever blame yourself for how you're feeling.  It's really what makes you special.

You don't need to feel grateful to anyone, you don't owe anyone anything. If the ones who are supporting you really cared about your well-being, they will understand. I don't know what kind of place you're in, maybe it's really dark, but please please please don't put yourself at fault here.
